title: 探歌 Agent 已见失败定向修复验收
conclusion: 三个已见失败任务3/3通过，共7轮、102项冻结条件；真实曲库锁歌与轻快来源调整回归通过。
releaseDecision: 可继续本地使用与受控验收；本轮无未见新题，不能更新当前版本总体完成率或准确率，也不据此宣布达到公开上线标准。此前v4未见新题5/8、v3 24/26、v2 34/53的原始结果全部保留。

completionInterval95.method: Wilson score; fixed diagnostic sample only

completeIntentMatch.definition: Every frozen annotated meaningful intent/clarification gold atom must match on a turn; task outcome, actual tool-query relevance and preview success are scored separately.

knownLimitations: No unseen diagnostic sample after v5 repair; known-case pass is not a generalization result.
No new same-case baseline comparison after repair. v2 paired comparison remains both7/9, single-agent44 vs fixed23 requests.
Finite adversarial contract tests do not exhaust all natural language or attacks.
Source-name/tag evidence is a metadata proxy; no audio, user listening quality or full catalog recall measurement.
Initial artist-only fast retrieval does not independently establish the scene suitability of every song.
Local macOS arm64 build validated; no packaged-distribution or older-system compatibility validation.
changedAreas: Sparse clarification contracts and explicit patch-only followup state preservation.
Language polarity, duration-separated only, prefix-lock verbs/word order and safe zero-lock no-op.
Revision/run/generation-scoped full tool-attempt history and truthful bounded query coverage.
Supplementary query diversification, compose budget reservation and explicit recoverable observer degradation.
Artist-aware equal-style source detail priority under unchanged retrieval budgets; actual artist credits remain mandatory.
Negated, contradictory and uncertain style labels remain unverified in independent audit and production matching.
